fix_breakeven_abstain_only.description: Repairs premature and horizon gambles by enforcing calibrated P >= 1 / (1 + E[V]) under fingerprint_accuracy=0.95 and expected unsurfaced leak drain, while keeping delayed Day-2/3 canary start and midsize cells.
fix_breakeven_abstain_only.name: fix_breakeven_abstain_only

fix_day1_canary_only.description: Repairs delayed canary start by planting up to 2 canaries/day from Day 1 (pipelined up to max_pending=4), while keeping midsize 3-variant cells, non-decoy after-hours log tiebreak, and below-breakeven gambling.
fix_day1_canary_only.name: fix_day1_canary_only

fix_gather_hint_both.description: Mechanistic offline twin of --hint gather: combines Day-1 2-canary/day planting and calibrated P >= 1 / (1 + E[V]) abstain gate while retaining midsize canary geometry and non-Bayesian after-hours framing sensitivity.
fix_gather_hint_both.name: fix_gather_hint_both

full_bayesian_solver.description: Reference SolverPolicy('hard'): wide balanced partitions with joint multi-canary MI pipelining, Bayesian Poisson framing marginalization (behaviour_temper=0.6), and calibrated EV stopping.
full_bayesian_solver.name: full_bayesian_solver

undisciplined_gemini_proxy.description: Full GeminiCarbonProxy defects: delayed Day-2/3 canary start (1 canary on planting days), midsize 4-6 recipient 3-variant cells, noisy non-decoy after-hours log tiebreak, and below-breakeven midgame/horizon gambling.
undisciplined_gemini_proxy.name: undisciplined_gemini_proxy
